other_conditions: Must have undertaken training in poultry farming from Government Poultry farms
Must not have previously availed any benefit under Commercial Broiler Schemes
Must not discontinue the scheme or violate its terms; otherwise must refund the entire amount with interest
Must provide a certified/authenticated copy of documents establishing ownership or possession of the land on which the shed is or will be constructed
Must submit a completion certificate duly verified by a Junior Engineer or higher rank officer
Approximately 100 farmers will be assisted per year
Previously assisted poultry breeders (more than two years old) may apply if their unit is still viable and operating successfully
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy covering 60% of the capital investment for commercial broiler farms, with beneficiaries contributing the remaining 40% (or arranging bank financing).
documents_required: Certified copy of land ownership/possession documents
Completion certificate verified by Junior Engineer or above
